components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action on forms and confirmations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: calc(0.65rem - 2px); background: hsl(143.3 80.6% 45.1%); color: #000000; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(143.3 80.6% 40.5%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(0 0% 97%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(142.1 76.2% 36.3%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions that should not compete with primary green.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); border-radius: calc(0.65rem - 2px); background: hsl(0 0% 97%); color: hsl(220 20% 10%); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(0 0% 97%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(142.1 76.2% 36.3%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard single-line field for login and forms.
components.css: .ds-input { display: flex; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); border-radius: calc(0.65rem - 2px); background: hsl(0 0% 97%); color: hsl(220 20% 10%); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(0 0% 97%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(142.1 76.2% 36.3%); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Grouped content container for forms, lists, and summaries.
components.html:
Caminhões
Gerencie a frota disponível para despacho.

Conteúdo do card.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 0.65rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); background: hsl(0 0% 100%); color: hsl(220 20% 10%); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); overflow: hidden; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { padding: 24px 24px 0; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card-desc { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-card-content { padding: 24px; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); }

components.name: Metric Summary Tile
components.description: Compact operational counter on page headers (frota, dashboards).
components.css: .ds-metric-tile { display: flex; min-height: 5.5rem; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; border-radius: 0.65rem; border: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); background: hsl(0 0% 100%); padding: 16px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; box-shadow: none; } .ds-metric-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-metric-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: hsl(220 20% 10%); } .ds-metric-value-accent { color: #16A34A; }

components.name: Destructive Alert
components.description: Section-level error with retry — does not block the full page.
components.html:
Erro ao carregar
Não foi possível carregar os dados.
components.css: .ds-alert-destructive { position: relative; width: 100%; border-radius: 0.65rem; border: 1px solid hsl(0 84.2% 60.2% / 0.5); background: hsl(0 0% 97%); padding: 16px 16px 16px 44px; color: hsl(0 84.2% 60.2%); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-alert-icon { position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 16px; width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-alert-title { margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; } .ds-alert-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; }

components.name: Skeleton Row
components.css: .ds-skeleton-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; } .ds-skeleton-row { height: 40px; width: 100%; border-radius: calc(0.65rem - 2px); background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); animation: ds-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.5; } }

components.name: Table Empty State
components.description: Centered empty table cell with icon, copy, and optional CTA.
components.html:
Nenhum caminhão cadastrado

Cadastre o primeiro caminhão para começar.
components.css: .ds-empty-state { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 32px 16px; text-align: center; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-empty-icon { color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1% / 0.6); } .ds-empty-title { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(220 20% 10%); } .ds-empty-desc { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Compact status or count label — primary variant.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; background: hsl(143.3 80.6% 45.1%); color: hsl(355.7 100% 97.3%); }

components.name: Badge Secondary
components.css: .ds-badge-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; background: hsl(240 4.8% 95.9%); color: hsl(240 5.9% 10%); }

components.name: Carga Status Chip
components.description: Domain-specific status for carga lifecycle states.
components.css: .ds-chip-carga-fechada { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: #16A34A; color: #ffffff; } .ds-chip-carga-aberta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; background: #A7F3D0; color: #064E3B; }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Operate-mode table for lists (caminhões, motoristas, cargas).
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-table th { border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(240 3.8% 46.1%); } .ds-table td { border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(240 5.9% 90%); padding: 12px 16px; color: hsl(220 20% 10%); } .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td { border-bottom: none; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Text link inside the green desktop navbar.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: hsl(355.7 100% 97.3%); text-decoration: none; border-radius: calc(0.65rem - 2px); transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: hsl(0 0% 97%); background: hsl(143.3 80.6% 40%); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px hsl(0 0% 97%), 0 0 0 4px hsl(142.1 76.2% 36.3%); }

components.name: Top Navbar
components.description: Desktop structural chrome with brand and module links.
components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; background: hsl(143.3 80.6% 45.1%); color: hsl(355.7 100% 97.3%); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-navbar-brand { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; } .ds-navbar-links { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

narrative.overview:
WorkaPool looks and behaves like a control room for daily operations—not a marketing site. Surfaces are light, information-dense, and organized around recurring jobs (cargas, pedidos, OS, metas). A confident Pool Green (hsl(143.3 80.6% 45.1%)) signals brand and primary action, while page bodies stay neutral so tables, cards, and status chips carry most of the visual signal.

The stack is shadcn/ui + Radix on Tailwind CSS variables (frontend/src/styles/tailwind.css, frontend/tailwind.config.js). Inter is the sole type family. Layout follows a desktop top bar + mobile bottom tab pattern (DefaultLayout). Polish is functional: borders, shadow-sm, and ring focus states—not decorative motion or hero imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Operate-mode density: tables, forms, and cards over empty marketing space
Green structural chrome (navbar) on neutral work surfaces
Semantic domain colors for Carga lifecycle and order negotiation states
shadcn component variants as the default extension point—not one-off inline styling
Per-section async states (skeleton, alert + retry) on multi-resource Operate screens
Sonner toasts for action confirmation after mutations

rules.name: The Green Bar Rule
rules.body: The full-width primary navbar is the only large-field green surface. Page content stays neutral; green appears in buttons, badges, and status chips—not full-bleed section backgrounds.

rules.name: The Status Color Rule
rules.body: Carga and order states use their dedicated tokens (carga-*, order-*). Do not improvise new hues for ABERTA, FECHADA, perdido, or bloqueado.

rules.name: The Token Not Hex Rule
rules.body: Prefer Tailwind semantic classes (text-carga-fechada, bg-order-mine-bg) over inline hex. Hex values belong in tokens and DESIGN.md frontmatter—not scattered in components.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Inter carries every role. Do not introduce a second typeface without explicit brand approval.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear on cards, modals, and the navbar—not on every list row or table cell.

dos: Do use semantic tokens (primary, muted, destructive, carga-*, order-*) via Tailwind classes or hsl(var(--token)).
Do keep labels and headings in Portuguese with domain terms from CONTEXT.md files.
Do extend shadcn variants (Button, Badge, Card) before creating bespoke styled divs.
Do preserve the green navbar + neutral body pattern on new authenticated screens.
Do use container mx-auto p-4 and bottom padding on mobile when adding fixed footers.
Do render layout shells immediately and load each card/section independently (skeleton → content or alert + retry).
Do use toast.success / toast.error (Sonner) after mutations; keep error copy in Portuguese.
donts: Don't introduce marketing-style hero sections, gradients, or decorative illustration in operational views.
Don't assign new arbitrary colors to Carga or order states—use the established semantic palette.
Don't gate an entire Operate page on a single loading && !error check when sections can fail or load independently.
Don't add a second global stylesheet with competing :root tokens (globals.css vs tailwind.css—main.tsx loads tailwind.css as authority).
Don't hide critical actions behind icon-only buttons without tooltips or labels.
Don't use English UI copy on staff-facing surfaces unless mirroring an established ERP field name.
